# Documentation index

*Generated by `src/analysis/docs_index.py` on 2026-08-21 05:31. Do not edit by hand — re-run it.*

Every figure and table in the report and the decks is produced by script from the files below. No number in any deliverable is entered by hand.

## Runs

- **12** matrix runs complete, **4** LR-sweep runs.
- Run ID format: `{model}_{dataset}_f{fraction}_s{seed}_{regime}`.
- Each `results/runs/<run_id>/` contains:

  | File | What it is |
  |---|---|
  | `config.yaml` | The exact merged config the run used — base <- model <- data <- CLI. *(present in 17 runs)* |
  | `train_log.csv` | Per epoch: losses, top-1/top-5, LR, epoch time, imgs/sec, peak VRAM. *(present in 17 runs)* |
  | `metrics.json` | Run summary: best val top-1, best epoch, params, VRAM, wall time, library versions. Its existence marks the run complete. *(present in 16 runs)* |
  | `clean_eval.json` | Frozen-test top-1/top-5/macro-F1 plus per-class accuracy. *(present in 12 runs)* |
  | `predictions.parquet` | Per-image: filepath, true label, prediction, confidence. Raw material for calibration and error overlap. *(present in 12 runs)* |
  | `eval_results.json` | The 42-pass battery: corruptions x severities, frequency sweeps, band-limited noise. *(present in 0 runs)* |

| Dataset | Regime | Model | Runs | Fractions | Seeds |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| caltech256 | fullft | resnet50 | 12 | [10, 25, 50, 100] | [0, 1, 2] |

## Derived tables (`results/tables/`)

| File | Rows | What it is | Produced by |
|---|---|---|---|
| `master.csv` | 12 | One row per run: config, clean metrics, every corruption cell and frequency point. THE source of truth — every reported number traces here. | `src/analysis/aggregate.py` |
| `per_class.csv` | 3,072 | Per-class accuracy for every run — the rare-class axis. | `src/analysis/aggregate.py` |
| `lr_sweep.csv` | 3 | The declared per-model LR sweeps and which point was selected. Evidence for the 'declared per-model tuning' claim. | `src/analysis/aggregate.py` |
| `deployment.csv` | 2 | Static cost (params, FLOPs) joined to measured cost (peak VRAM, throughput). | `src/analysis/aggregate.py` |
| `compute_ledger.csv` | 1 | Where the GPU-hours went, per block. | `src/analysis/aggregate.py` |
| `calibration.csv` | 12 | ECE, MCE, mean confidence and over-confidence gap per run. | `src/analysis/calibration.py` |
| `reliability.csv` | 180 | Per-bin reliability data behind the diagrams. | `src/analysis/calibration.py` |
| `model_cost.csv` | 2 | Params / GMACs / feature dim, measured with torch's FLOP counter. | `src/utils/provenance.py` |
| `environment.json` | — | Machine, driver, kernel, library versions and git commit at capture time. | `src/utils/provenance.py` |

## Quantitative figures (`results/figures/`)

| File | Title | Caption | Defined by |
|---|---|---|---|
| `fig_data_efficiency.png` | Data-efficiency curves | Frozen-test top-1 against the nested per-class training fraction. Line is the mean over 3 seeds, band is +/-1 SD. Solid = full fine-tuning, dashed = linear probe on frozen features. | `results/tables/master.csv` |
| `fig_calibration.png` | Calibration | Left: reliability diagram at f100 -- points below the diagonal are over-confident. Right: expected calibration error against training fraction, mean over seeds. | `results/tables/calibration.csv` |
| `fig_deployment.png` | Deployment cost | Static cost (parameters, GMACs at 224) and cost measured on the real workload (peak training VRAM, training throughput on an RTX 4060 8 GB). | `results/tables/deployment.csv` |

*Each figure is written as both `.png` (slides) and `.pdf` (report, vector).*

## Qualitative assets (`results/figures/assets/`)

| File | Title | Caption | Defined by |
|---|---|---|---|
| `dataset_samples.png` | Caltech-256 samples | Sixteen images drawn at random (seed 0) from the frozen test split, after the deterministic evaluation transform Resize(256)+CenterCrop(224). | `src/data/transforms.py` |
| `class_distribution.png` | Class imbalance | Per-class test-set counts, ranked. The tail is why macro-F1 and worst-decile class accuracy are reported alongside top-1. | `src/data/make_splits.py` |
| `augmentation_samples.png` | Training augmentation | RandomResizedCrop(224, scale 0.5-1.0) + horizontal flip + light colour jitter (0.2/0.2/0.2, hue 0). Deliberately modest: mixup/cutmix/RandAugment are excluded as confounds. De-normalised for display. | `src/data/transforms.py` |
| `corruption_ladder.png` | Corruption severities | Three corruption families at five ImageNet-C severities. Applied to the 224x224 crop in [0,1] before normalisation, seeded per (image, severity) so both architectures score on byte-identical inputs. Never written to disk. | `src/eval/corruptions.py` |
| `frequency_lowpass_ladder.png` | Ideal lowpass sweep | Ideal (brick-wall) lowpass filtering at each swept cutoff radius. Radius is in DFT bins; 112 bins = Nyquist along an axis, and 159 covers the corner so the low-pass mask there is the identity. Ringing is the expected Gibbs artefact of a sharp spectral cutoff. | `src/eval/frequency.py` |
| `frequency_highpass_ladder.png` | Ideal highpass sweep | Ideal (brick-wall) highpass filtering at each swept cutoff radius. Radius is in DFT bins; 112 bins = Nyquist along an axis, and 159 covers the corner so the low-pass mask there is the identity. Ringing is the expected Gibbs artefact of a sharp spectral cutoff. | `src/eval/frequency.py` |
| `band_noise_ladder.png` | Band-limited noise sweep | Gaussian noise confined to one frequency annulus and rescaled to a fixed spatial RMS of 0.1. Holding energy constant is what makes band index the only variable, so the resulting curve measures model sensitivity rather than how many DFT bins an annulus happens to contain. | `src/eval/frequency.py` |
| `fft_construction.png` | FFT probe construction | The demo image, its centred log-magnitude spectrum, and three of the binary radial masks the sweep multiplies it by. Low- and high-pass masks at the same radius are exact complements, which the module's self-test asserts (lowpass + highpass reconstructs the original to 4e-07). | `src/eval/frequency.py` |
| `fraction_nesting.png` | Nested data fractions | Each smaller fraction is a strict per-class subset of the larger one, so the data-efficiency curve varies only quantity, never composition. Three independent seed nestings give the error bands. | `src/data/make_splits.py` |

*Each figure is written as both `.png` (slides) and `.pdf` (report, vector).*

## Reproducing everything

```bash
bash scripts/run_lr_sweep_resnet50.sh   # declared LR sweep, CNN
bash scripts/run_lr_sweep_vit_b16.sh    # declared LR sweep, ViT
bash scripts/run_pipeline.sh            # matrix -> probes -> battery -> analysis
FOOD101=1 bash scripts/run_pipeline.sh  # ... and the Food-101 block
python report/build/build_decks.py      # six decks
python report/build/build_reports.py    # two reports
```
